properties.name: solomon.mq.idempotency.enabled
properties.description: Enable the starter-provided MessageIdempotencyExecutor. Keep this disabled unless consumers use stable msgId values and duplicate delivery should be skipped.

properties.name: solomon.mq.idempotency.processing-ttl
properties.description: How long a message id stays in the processing state before another delivery may retry it.

properties.name: solomon.mq.idempotency.consumed-ttl
properties.description: How long a successfully consumed message id is remembered to suppress duplicate delivery. Provide a Redis or database MessageIdempotencyStore for production clusters.
